output.answer_markdown: In its fiscal 2020 10-K, HP Inc. says that failing to comply with customer contract provisions or government contracting regulations could result in civil and criminal penalties. These may include termination of contracts, forfeiture of profits, suspension of payments and, for government contracts, fines and suspension from future government contracting. Such failures could also cause reputational damage [1]. In addition, the filing notes that HP has in the past been, and may in the future be, subject to qui tam litigation brought by private individuals on behalf of the government, which could include claims for treble damages [1]. Negative publicity about customer contracts or related proceedings could hurt its ability to compete for new contracts [1].
